blocks.text: Unwind with a big screen Unwind with a large, beautiful 10.9" screen. Whether you’re a multitasker, a gamer or a devoted movie watcher, you’ll feel closer to the action. Plus, dual speakers make everything sound amazing. Circle anything. Search everything. Simply circle to search for virtually anything you can see on your Galaxy Tab S10 FE. From discovering where to buy those awesome shoes to getting a recipe for that dish your friend just posted, find answers using Circle to Search with Google. Water resistant, from drops to dunks From droplets to splashes to full immersion in water, you can feel secure taking your Galaxy Tab S10 FE with you. It’s one of the only water-and dust-resistant tablets⁵. Pen-point precision Write up to-do lists by hand, or enjoy drawing during your free time. S Pen features a responsive design that feels like you’re writing on actual paper so nothing gets in your way when your imagination is flowing. Great battery. Fast charging. Stay ready to indulge in your downtime. Finish your favorite series or book with a battery that can last up to 20 hours. Front and rear cameras for clear video calls Stay connected with a great camera on Galaxy Tab S10 FE that makes video calls clearer and more engaging. Whether you’re catching up with friends or showing off your latest creation, you’ll always look your best. Plus, with a large display, you can see every expression and detail, making conversations feel more natural and immersive. File sharing made easy Sending and receiving files is so easy with Quick Share¹⁵.From cute puppy videos to large work files, transfer to and from your Tab in a snap —it even works when sending to non-Galaxy devices. Expand your workspace Sometimes big ideas need a little more room to come to life. Expand your workspace by connecting to another device to use as a second screen —like your Galaxy Book.1Now you’ve got two screens so you can create comfortably.
